items.claim: Stephanie Luciano has proven talent and a very good skill set in WMMA.
items.quote: whenever there's a proven talent like a Stephanie Luciano, who I'm actually pretty high on in WMA, I think that she's got a very good skill set.

items.claim: Marina Spasic has a background in Muay Thai and kickboxing.
items.quote: She's got the Muay Thai background, kickboxing background. She's competed in those arts.

items.claim: Marina Spasic's movement in MMA can be a little plodding.
items.quote: I feel like she needs to do a little bit of a better job in terms of the movement, right? a little bit plotty
